steps: A transport connection exposes addresses and ports.
L4 forwards packets without understanding application content.
An HTTP request exposes method, host, headers, and path.
L7 applies content-aware routing at higher processing cost.

lesson.scenario: A payments endpoint separates high-throughput TCP distribution from HTTP-aware canary selection.
